root_cause.text: An off-by-one error in the loop condition of `dlm_match_regions()` in `fs/ocfs2/dlm/dlmdomain.c` uses `<=` instead of `<` when iterating over `qr->qr_numregions`, causing an out-of-bounds read of the `qr_regions` array.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that the loop condition in `dlm_match_regions()` is changed from `for (j = 0; j <= qr->qr_numregions; ++j)` to `for (j = 0; j < qr->qr_numregions; ++j)` to prevent reading past the valid range of the `qr_regions` array.
